description: Machine-readable definition of the dcc-mcp repository contract. Consumed by scripts/check_repo_contract.py (CI gate) and by the vx-repo-contract skill (local check). Both read this file, so the pass/fail criteria are defined exactly once.

profiles.baseline: Rules that every repository is expected to satisfy today. Adopting repositories start here and ratchet up.
profiles.strict: All rules including the ones still being rolled out by PIP-3734/3735/3736/3737/3738. Opt in per repository once it is clean.

rules.name: no-root-artifacts
rules.title: No build or test artifacts at the repository root
rules.summary: Files matching forbidden_artifact_globs must not appear as top-level entries.

rules.name: justfile-lowercase
rules.title: The just recipe file is lowercase `justfile`
rules.summary: just only auto-discovers `justfile` or `.justfile`. A capitalised `Justfile` works on case-insensitive filesystems only and silently breaks Linux CI.

rules.name: agents-md-exists
rules.title: AGENTS.md exists at the repository root
rules.summary: AGENTS.md is the single source of truth for agent instructions. A repository without it gives every agent a different starting context.

rules.name: vx-toml-parses
rules.title: vx.toml is valid TOML with known tables
rules.summary: vx.toml must parse. Unknown top-level tables are reported so that drift is visible.

rules.name: tools-version-format
rules.title: Every [tools] pin uses a recognised version form
rules.summary: A pin must be `stable`, `latest`, or numeric `X`, `X.Y`, or `X.Y.Z`. Anything else (a bare channel name, a range, a URL) is not resolvable by vx and is rejected. A tool named in tools_delegation_sentinels may instead declare that another manager owns it; that is an ownership declaration rather than a version, and it is accepted for that tool only.

rules.name: root-allowlist
rules.title: Every top-level entry is on the allowlist
rules.summary: Top-level entries outside root_allowlist must move under docs/ or be deleted. Entries on root_deprecated are tolerated but emit a migration hint.

rules.name: no-scripts-with-justfile
rules.title: A repository with a justfile has no vx.toml [scripts]
rules.summary: [scripts] entries that only shell out to `just <recipe>` duplicate the justfile and drift. Keep recipes in justfile; keep [scripts] only when there is no justfile.

rules.name: agents-derived-symlink
rules.title: Derived agent files point back at AGENTS.md
rules.summary: CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and friends must be symlinks to AGENTS.md, or generated files carrying the provenance marker. Hand-edited copies drift from the source of truth.

rules.name: tools-no-latest
rules.title: [tools] pins are concrete, not `latest`
rules.summary: `latest` makes a build unreproducible. Pin a version once the PIP-3737 baseline is agreed; tools on tools_latest_allowed may stay on `latest`.

rules.name: llms-txt-fresh
rules.title: llms.txt exists when a generator exists
rules.summary: If the repository ships an llms.txt generator, llms.txt must exist at the root and be listed as generated. A missing llms.txt means the docs contract is only half applied.

rules.name: no-tracked-agent-dirs
rules.title: No version-controlled files under an agent or IDE directory
rules.summary: Files tracked under any agents_ide_dir must not be committed. These directories are runtime mount points populated from the workspace skill registry, so a committed copy is never the code that runs and silently forks from the registry. Add the anchored pattern to .gitignore and untrack the files, or move a shared asset to a committed path outside the agent directories. R008 only warns that the directory exists; R011 reports each tracked file, because a directory warning is easy to scroll past when the tree is large.

root_deprecated..travis.yml: Travis CI is retired. Move the pipeline to .github/workflows/.
root_deprecated..hound.yml: Hound is retired. Use pre-commit with ruff.
root_deprecated..coveragerc: Move coverage settings into [tool.coverage] in pyproject.toml.
root_deprecated..flake8: Flake8 is superseded by ruff. Move settings into [tool.ruff] in pyproject.toml.
root_deprecated..pylintrc: Pylint is superseded by ruff. Move settings into [tool.ruff] in pyproject.toml.
root_deprecated..travis.yaml: Travis CI is retired. Move the pipeline to .github/workflows/.
root_deprecated.skills: Agent skills are not vendored per repository. For a Monica-managed run the workspace skill registry is authoritative (`monica skill get <id> --with-content`); `loonghao/vx` `skills/` is the global `vx ai setup` install source. Some IDE/CLI runtimes do load a committed copy from their own directory, which is why committing one is worse than redundant: it forks from the registry and silently drifts.
